paragraphs.zh: Die Erfindung betrifft das technische Gebiet der Pflanzenschutzmittel.
paragraphs.en: The invention relates to the technical field of crop protection agents.

paragraphs.zh: Spezieller betrifft sie eine thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation von 2-({2-Chlor-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluorethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexan-1,3-dion der Formel [STRUKTURFORMEL: siehe drawings[0]], (im Folgenden als Tembotrione bezeichnet), Verfahren zu ihrer Herstellung und deren Verwendung als Herbizid.
paragraphs.en: More particularly it relates to a thermodynamically stable crystal modification of 2-({2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexane-1,3-dione of the formula [STRUCTURAL FORMULA: see drawings[0]], (hereinafter referred to as tembotrione), processes for its preparation and its use as a herbicide.
paragraphs.notes: THIS PARAGRAPH WRAPS AROUND THE ONLY DRAWN CHEMICAL STRUCTURE IN THE PATENT. The prose breaks after 'der Formel', the structural formula is set centred and alone below it (spanning roughly margin lines 10 to 15), and the prose resumes with '(im Folgenden als Tembotrione bezeichnet)'. A single comma is printed on its own at the right-hand end of the structure line, closing the 'der Formel ... ,' construction; it is part of this sentence and is reproduced immediately after the structure token. The token [STRUKTURFORMEL: siehe drawings[0]] / [STRUCTURAL FORMULA: see drawings[0]] is an EDITORIAL INSERT, not printed text, marking where the image sits; everything else in these two fields is as printed. The extracted text layer contains no trace of the structure at all - it runs straight from 'der Formel' to '(im Folgenden' - so the drawing exists downstream only through drawings[0]. Note that build_enriched.py anchors a drawing after its preceding paragraph, so the IMAGE_EXTRACT span will be emitted after this whole paragraph; the true position is mid-paragraph, as described here. The printed name uses the locants 2-Chlor-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluorethoxy)methyl], i.e. not in ascending locant order; transcribed as printed. The German spelling 'trifluorethoxy' (no o before 'ethoxy') is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Es ist bekannt, dass einige organische Verbindungen in nur einer Kristallstruktur, andere (sog. Polymorphe) in verschiedenen Kristallstrukturen auftreten können, siehe dazu beispielsweise J. Bernstein, R.J. Davey, J.O. Henck, Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 1999, 38, 3440-3461. So sind aus EP 1 314 724 A1 zwei Kristallstrukturen des herbiziden Wirkstoffs Sulcotrione bekannt.
paragraphs.en: It is known that some organic compounds occur in only one crystal structure, while others (so-called polymorphs) can occur in different crystal structures; see for example J. Bernstein, R.J. Davey, J.O. Henck, Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 1999, 38, 3440-3461. Thus two crystal structures of the herbicidal active ingredient sulcotrione are known from EP 1 314 724 A1.
paragraphs.notes: The citation is printed with the initials 'J.O. Henck'. The author of the 1999 Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. polymorphism review is Jan-Olav Henck, so 'J.O.' is read as printed and not expanded. The EP number is printed with spaces, 'EP 1 314 724 A1', and the volume/page run as '1999, 38, 3440-3461'; both reproduced exactly. Sulcotrione, the prior-art polymorph case, is a different active ingredient from tembotrione; no structure is drawn for it anywhere.

paragraphs.zh: Das beispielsweise aus WO 00/21924 (dort Beispiel Nr. 3 in Tabelle 1) bekannte Tembotrione besitzt herbizide Eigenschaften und eignet sich für die Herstellung von Pflanzenschutzmitteln, die zur Unkrautbekämpfung herangezogen werden. Jedoch hat sich gezeigt, dass das gemäß der Offenbarung von WO 00/21924 herstellbare Tembotrione sich nicht für die Herstellung von anwenderfreundlichen Darreichungsformen eignet. Anwenderfreundliche Darreichungsformen sind beispielsweise Suspensionsformulierungen, in denen Tembotrione feinvermahlen in fester Form vorliegt. In der praktischen Ausprüfung hat sich gezeigt, dass das gemäß der Offenbarung von WO 00/21924 herstellbare Tembotrione in Suspensionsformulierungen zu Kristallwachstum und in Folge dessen zu Ausklumpen und Ausfällungen führt, sodass die Suspensionsformulierung unbrauchbar wird. Das Kristallwachstum kann spontan auftreten oder über einen längeren Zeitraum erfolgen und kann nicht vorhergesagt werden.
paragraphs.en: The tembotrione known for example from WO 00/21924 (Example No. 3 in Table 1 there) has herbicidal properties and is suitable for the preparation of crop protection agents used for weed control. However, it has been found that the tembotrione preparable according to the disclosure of WO 00/21924 is not suitable for the preparation of user-friendly dosage forms. User-friendly dosage forms are, for example, suspension formulations in which tembotrione is present finely milled in solid form. In practical testing it has been found that the tembotrione preparable according to the disclosure of WO 00/21924 leads in suspension formulations to crystal growth and, as a consequence, to clumping and precipitation, so that the suspension formulation becomes unusable. The crystal growth can occur spontaneously or over a longer period and cannot be predicted.
paragraphs.notes: Two typographic hyphens repaired here: 'Darreichungsfor-men' -> 'Darreichungsformen' and 'Tem-botrione' -> 'Tembotrione'. The prior-art reference is printed 'WO 00/21924' three times, always with the slash and no space. This paragraph is the only place on the page that identifies the substance tembotrione itself as prior art; the invention claimed is the crystal modification, not the compound.

paragraphs.zh: Aufgabe der vorliegenden Erfindung war die Bereitstellung einer Modifikation von Tembotrione, die diese Nachteile überwindet und für die Herstellung einer über einen längeren Zeitraum lagerstabilen Suspensionsformulierung geeignet ist.
paragraphs.en: The object of the present invention was to provide a modification of tembotrione which overcomes these disadvantages and is suitable for the preparation of a suspension formulation that is storage-stable over a longer period.

paragraphs.zh: Es wurde eine thermodynamisch stabile in einem orthorhombischen System kristallisierende Modifikation von Tembotrione gefunden, die die oben genannten Nachteile nicht aufweist und daher für die Herstellung von Suspensionsformulierungen wie Suspokonzentraten, Suspoemulsionen und Öldispersionen besonders geeignet ist.
paragraphs.en: A thermodynamically stable modification of tembotrione crystallising in an orthorhombic system has been found which does not have the disadvantages mentioned above and is therefore particularly suitable for the preparation of suspension formulations such as suspension concentrates, suspoemulsions and oil dispersions.
paragraphs.notes: Typographic hyphen repaired: 'Suspensi-onsformulierungen' -> 'Suspensionsformulierungen'. 'Suspokonzentraten' is printed as such (the formulation-technology term for suspension concentrates, SC); translated by its accepted English equivalent and not left untranslated.

paragraphs.zh: Ein Gegenstand der Erfindung ist daher eine in einem orthorhombischen System kristallisierende Modifikation von 2-({2-Chlor-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluorethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexan-1,3-dion (Tembotrione).
paragraphs.en: One subject of the invention is therefore a modification, crystallising in an orthorhombic system, of 2-({2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexane-1,3-dione (tembotrione).
paragraphs.notes: The systematic name here is character-for-character identical to the one in [0002], including the non-ascending locant order and the brace/bracket nesting. It is the second of the two places on this page that name the drawn structure, and it was used as the cross-check on drawings[0].

paragraphs.zh: Im Rahmen der vorliegenden Erfindung wurde festgestellt, dass Tembotrione außer der in einem orthorhombischen System kristallisierenden stabilen Modifikation auch in mindestens zwei metastabilen Modifikationen auftritt.
paragraphs.en: In the context of the present invention it was found that, besides the stable modification crystallising in an orthorhombic system, tembotrione also occurs in at least two metastable modifications.

paragraphs.zh: Im Folgenden werden die Begriffe "stabile Modifikation I", "stabile Kristallmodifikation I", "thermodynamisch stabile Modifikation I" und "thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation I" als gleichbedeutend verstanden.
paragraphs.en: In what follows, the terms "stable modification I", "stable crystal modification I", "thermodynamically stable modification I" and "thermodynamically stable crystal modification I" are understood as synonymous.
paragraphs.notes: The quotation marks are printed as straight double quotes in this face, not German typographic quotes; reproduced as straight quotes. This paragraph is a definition and matters downstream: it makes four different phrases in this document refer to one and the same crystal modification I.

paragraphs.zh: Die stabile Modifikation hat einen Schmelzpunkt von 124,0°C, ein charakteristisches Raman-Spektrum (Abb. 1) und ein charakteristisches Infrarot-Spektrum (Abb. 1a). Sie wird nachfolgend als Kristallmodifikation I bezeichnet.
paragraphs.en: The stable modification has a melting point of 124.0 degrees C, a characteristic Raman spectrum (Fig. 1) and a characteristic infrared spectrum (Fig. 1a). It is referred to hereinafter as crystal modification I.
paragraphs.notes: German decimal comma reproduced as printed: 124,0. There is NO space between the number and the degree sign here ('124,0°C'), unlike [0012] which prints '121,6 °C' with a space; both are recorded exactly as printed and the difference is in the original, not an artifact of transcription. 'Abb.' is the German abbreviation for Abbildung (figure); rendered 'Fig.' in English. Abbildungen 1 and 1a are on later sheets and carry no text.

paragraphs.zh: Die eine metastabile Modifikation hat einen Schmelzpunkt von 123,9°C, ein charakteristisches Raman-Spektrum (Abb. 2) und ein charakteristisches Infrarot-Spektrum (Abb. 2a). Sie wird nachfolgend als Kristallmodifikation II bezeichnet.
paragraphs.en: The one metastable modification has a melting point of 123.9 degrees C, a characteristic Raman spectrum (Fig. 2) and a characteristic infrared spectrum (Fig. 2a). It is referred to hereinafter as crystal modification II.
paragraphs.notes: Typographic hyphen repaired: 'Raman-Spek-trum' -> 'Raman-Spektrum'. The hyphen inside 'Raman-Spektrum' is real and is kept; only the one at the line break was removed. '123,9°C' is printed with no space before the degree sign.

paragraphs.zh: Die zweite metastabile Modifikation hat einen Schmelzpunkt von 121,6 °C, ein charakteristisches Raman-Spektrum (Abb. 3) und ein charakteristisches Infrarot-Spektrum (Abb. 3a). Sie wird nachfolgend als Kristallmodifikation III bezeichnet.
paragraphs.en: The second metastable modification has a melting point of 121.6 degrees C, a characteristic Raman spectrum (Fig. 3) and a characteristic infrared spectrum (Fig. 3a). It is referred to hereinafter as crystal modification III.
paragraphs.notes: This is the one melting point on the page printed WITH a space before the degree sign: '121,6 °C'. Reproduced as printed. Typographic hyphen repaired: 'Raman-Spektrum' is broken across the line as 'Raman-' / 'Spektrum' at the line end, and the internal hyphen is real, so the word is reassembled with its hyphen intact.

paragraphs.zh: Die Einkristallstrukturanalyse der Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione zeigt für diese Kristallmodifikation charakteristische Bindungswinkel und Bindungslängen, die in Tabelle 3 angegeben sind.
paragraphs.en: The single-crystal structure analysis of crystal modification I of tembotrione shows bond angles and bond lengths characteristic of this crystal modification, which are given in Table 3.
paragraphs.notes: Forward reference to Tabelle 3, which is not on this page.

paragraphs.zh: Die Einkristallstrukturanalyse der Kristallmodifikation II von Tembotrione zeigt für diese Kristallmodifikation charakteristische Bindungswinkel und Bindungslängen, die in Tabelle 4 angegeben sind.
paragraphs.en: The single-crystal structure analysis of crystal modification II of tembotrione shows bond angles and bond lengths characteristic of this crystal modification, which are given in Table 4.
paragraphs.notes: Forward reference to Tabelle 4, which is not on this page. Identical wording to [0013] apart from I -> II and Tabelle 3 -> Tabelle 4.

paragraphs.zh: Die Röntgen-Pulver-Diffraktometrie der Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione zeigt für diese Kristallmodifikation charakteristische Peaks, die in Tabelle 5 angegeben sind.
paragraphs.en: X-ray powder diffractometry of crystal modification I of tembotrione shows peaks characteristic of this crystal modification, which are given in Table 5.
paragraphs.notes: Both hyphens in 'Röntgen-Pulver-Diffraktometrie' are real parts of the compound noun, not line breaks. Forward reference to Tabelle 5, which is not on this page.

paragraphs.zh: Die Röntgen-Pulver-Diffraktometrie der Kristallmodifikation II von Tembotrione zeigt für diese Kristallmodifikation charakteristische Peaks, die in Tabelle 6 angegeben sind.
paragraphs.en: X-ray powder diffractometry of crystal modification II of tembotrione shows peaks characteristic of this crystal modification, which are given in Table 6.
paragraphs.notes: Typographic hyphen repaired: 'Kristallmodifika-tion' -> 'Kristallmodifikation'. Last paragraph printed on this page; [0017] begins on the next page. Forward reference to Tabelle 6.

structures.position_in_drawing: 1st and only, centred alone between the two halves of paragraph [0002], spanning roughly margin lines 10 to 15
structures.core: Two rings in one molecule: a cyclohexane-1,3-dione on the left, drawn fully saturated with no ring C=C and no enol OH, joined through a ketone (C=O) bridge to a benzene ring on the right. The benzene is drawn as a hexagon with two vertical sides (vertices at top, upper-right, lower-right, bottom, lower-left, upper-left) with three inner Kekule lines. The cyclohexanedione ring is drawn in the same orientation.
substituents: cyclohexanedione ring: =O at C1, drawn as a double bond running straight up from the ring's top vertex to a capital O
cyclohexanedione ring: =O at C3, drawn as a double bond running down-right from the ring's lower-right vertex to a capital O

cyclohexanedione ring: the aroyl group C(=O)Ar at C2, i.e. at the upper-right ring vertex, which is the vertex lying between the two carbonyl-bearing vertices; the bond runs up-right to the bridging carbonyl carbon
cyclohexanedione ring: C4, C5 and C6 are bare vertices (CH2); no ring double bond and no OH is drawn anywhere in this ring
bridging carbonyl carbon: =O drawn straight up to a capital O; bonds down-left to cyclohexanedione C2 and down-right to benzene C1
benzene C1 (ipso, the upper-left vertex): the bridging C(=O) group
Cl at C2 (the benzene top vertex, adjacent to ipso going clockwise); label 'Cl' printed above the ring

CH2-O-CH2-CF3 at C3 (the benzene upper-right vertex); drawn out as a chain: bond up-right from the ring to a bare apex vertex (CH2), then down-right to a capital O, then up-right to a second bare apex vertex (CH2), then down-right to the printed label CF3 with a subscript 3
SO2CH3 at C4 (the benzene lower-right vertex); printed as the label SO2CH3 with subscript 2 and subscript 3, to the lower right of the ring
H at C5 (benzene bottom vertex) and H at C6 (benzene lower-left vertex); both drawn as bare vertices
benzene Kekule double bonds drawn as inner lines on C1=C2, C3=C4 and C5=C6
structures.name: 2-[2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl]cyclohexane-1,3-dione (tembotrione)

drawings.notes: THE ONLY DRAWN CHEMICAL STRUCTURE IN THE WHOLE PATENT. It is a lone standalone formula: no arrow, no reagent label, no condition, no numbering and no atom labels other than the heteroatom and group labels listed in substituents. HOW THE POSITIONS WERE OBTAINED: read off the drawing geometry at high magnification FIRST, and only afterwards compared with the printed name in [0002] and [0007]. The benzene hexagon has two vertical sides; the bond to the bridging ketone leaves the upper-left vertex, so that vertex is the ipso carbon C1. Going clockwise from it the vertices are top (Cl), upper-right (CH2OCH2CF3), lower-right (SO2CH3), bottom (bare) and lower-left (bare). That gives 2-Cl, 3-CH2OCH2CF3, 4-SO2CH3, which agrees with the printed name; the agreement is a check, not the source. Likewise the cyclohexanedione: the vertex carrying the aroyl bond has a carbonyl vertex immediately on either side of it, which is what makes it C2 of a 1,3-dione; that too was read from the drawing before the name was consulted. TAUTOMER: the left ring is drawn in the diketo (2-acyl-1,3-dione) form. No enol OH and no ring C=C is drawn, so C2 carries one implicit H as drawn. PRESENTED_AS: the enum has no value for 'the subject compound of the patent', which is what this is. 'invention_route' is recorded because this is the compound of the invention rather than a prior-art route, but the drawing is not a route at all: this patent discloses no synthesis and not one bond is formed or broken in it. Note the substance itself is prior art (known from WO 00/21924 per [0004]); what is claimed is its crystal modification. The same structure and the same SMILES appear at [0059] of the reference run runs/CN104292137A, reached there by an independent read; the two agree. The drawn structure is C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.82, counted from the drawing: 6 C + 2 O + 7 H (dione ring), 1 C + 1 O (bridge), 6 C + 2 H (arene), 1 C + 2 H (ArCH2), 1 O (ether), 1 C + 2 H (OCH2), 1 C + 3 F (CF3), 1 S + 2 O + 1 C + 3 H (SO2CH3). SMILES CROSS-CHECK: RDKit is not installed in this context, so the SMILES was verified by hand, atom by atom against the drawing, and by the formula count above; it was not machine-parsed here. build_enriched.py will canonicalise it and will report it if RDKit rejects it. DISCREPANCIES AND ILLEGIBLE ARE EMPTY AS A FINDING, NOT AS AN OMISSION: the drawn structure was compared substituent by substituent against both printed names on this page ([0002] and [0007]) and against the prose, and they agree on every position; and every glyph on the page is sharp and legible, this being a born-digital PDF, so there is nothing to record as [illegible].
